summary: Cleanup routine for a global AVI stream handle: passes the address of the global dword_7CD208 to AVIStreamCleanup to release the stream, snapshots the global value into a local, and when that value is non-null frees the object via FreeWrapper_7bcf. Returns the freed pointer's result on the non-null path, otherwise the (null) snapshot of the global.

operations.description: Release the AVI stream: AVIStreamCleanup((int)&dword_7CD208) is called with the address of the global stream-handle slot.
Snapshot the global stream-handle value: result = dword_7CD208 is read into a local for the null check and the null-path return.
Guard on the global stream-handle value: the object is only freed when dword_7CD208 is non-null.
Free the object: FreeWrapper_7bcf((LPVOID)dword_7CD208) is invoked on the non-null global value.
Return the value of the FreeWrapper_7bcf call when the global was non-null, else the snapshotted (null) global value.
